# MCP Tool Catalog

<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen`; do not edit by hand. -->

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `generate_image` | Generate images via AI |
| `generate_video` | Generate videos via AI (async submit → poll) |
| `generate_music` | Generate music via AI (async submit → poll) |
| `generate_speech` | Convert text to speech (TTS) |
| `generate_sfx` | Generate a short sound effect (SFX) |
| `transcribe_audio` | Transcribe audio to text (STT) |
| `midjourney_imagine` | Midjourney image generation (costs 5-10x more than generate_image and produces 4 variants). Only use when the user explicitly asks for Midjourney, or needs highly artistic/stylized/painted results. For most use cases, prefer generate_image instead. |
| `midjourney_describe` | Get a text description of an image (reverse prompt). Upload an image URL and get back a prompt that MJ would use to generate it. |
| `midjourney_reroll` | Regenerate a Midjourney generation (same prompt, new results). Requires a previous MJ task ID. |
| `midjourney_video` | Turn an image into a short video via Midjourney. |
| `list_models` | List available models |
| `get_model_pricing` | Query model pricing details |
| `get_balance` | Query API key or account balance |
| `get_task` | Query async task/job status |
| `get_config` | Get current effective configuration (provider, model, size, etc.) |
| `caption_image` | Read or write image caption |
| `search_ideas` | Search AI prompt ideas |
| `remove_background` | Remove image background (offline) |
| `convert_depth` | Convert image/video to grayscale depth map (offline) |
| `upscale` | Upscale image resolution 2x/4x (offline) |
| `detect_image` | Detect AIGC/watermark in images (offline) |
| `remove_watermark` | Remove visible AI watermark |
| `add_watermark` | Add visible AI watermark (test only) |
| `crop_watermark` | Crop image to remove watermarks (no learning required) |
| `recognize_text` | Recognize text in images/PDF using offline OCR |
| `redact_text` | Redact PII in plain text (rules, dictionary, optional model) |
| `redact_check` | Check text or DOCX for leftover sensitive values |
| `redact_scan` | Scan a text/DOCX/PDF/image file for PII without writing |
| `redact_apply` | Redact a text/DOCX/PDF/image file and write the result |
| `redact_restore` | Restore a redacted DOCX from its mapping |
| `search` | Search the web with the built-in free engine (DuckDuckGo) |
| `fetch` | Fetch a URL with the built-in free fetcher (HTML→markdown) |
| `web_search` | Search the web via the configured third-party provider (may bill) |
| `web_fetch` | Fetch a URL via the configured third-party fetch API (may bill) |
| `kb_find` | Search the local knowledge base |
| `kb_search` | Search the web and save to the knowledge base |
| `kb_add` | Add a local file to the knowledge base |
| `kb_fetch` | Fetch a URL and save to the knowledge base |
| `kb_list` | List all documents in the knowledge base |
| `kb_show` | Show the full content of a document by ID |
